rubric_items.reason: All known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-4) and the assumed REQ-5 are traced: S-1 covers REQ-1, REQ-2 and REQ-5, and S-2 covers REQ-3 and REQ-4.
S-2 has one outcome. S-1 combines showing the count, updating it, and the paging scope under one outcome. That is acceptable but slightly broad.
Every criterion uses Given/When/Then. S-1 AC3 can only be checked if the list is paged, which is still unknown (U-1).
The values '12 patients' and '0 patients' come straight from the intent's REQ-1 and REQ-3. No invented limits.
Readable and consistent. The body's acceptance criteria are shortened versions of the front-matter text, and the front-matter U-1 has no text.
